title: Seemingly unpurchased DLC in my RPG Maker MV files?

posts.author: MrFluffFluff
posts.body: I got bored and clicked a random button and got to the resource manager, curiously I clicked dlc and there were a bunch of items there I haven't purchased. I haven't purchased any DLC, so I don't know where it came from. I bought and downloaded RPG Maker through steam, in case you need that info. I'm just really confused, and anxious that I did something wrong. Please tell me this is all supposed to be here?

posts.author: Avery
posts.body: The freebies folder already might give it away... those are just free packs for the users to enjoy

posts.author: Sword_of_Dusk
posts.body:

There's not really a case of "accidental piracy". At least if you're not being foolish. Either you knowingly pirated something or you didn't. Now, you might buy something using illegal assets, but that's not on you if it happens.
If you grab something from an unofficial site, getting a pirated copy is entirely on you for using a shady storefront. Steam is a lot of things, but shady ain't one of them.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
part of those resources were part of the original editor package, sometimes in different forms to allow you to decide what to use (compressed means smaller filesizes at lesser quality for example).
others were freebies from different events here on the board, or collections of free resources offered for the editor package by users from here.
